answer: Charge identities by funding source: the first account from a wallet cluster joins free, but the nth pays 2^n credits, so 10 fakes cost 1,023 credits against 10 for honest users. A newcomer can rest in a garden of low-fee slots and a ledge of small stipends; a crystal-clear audit trail flags clusters. Weakness: patient attackers can launder funding through unrelated wallets.
